verdict:
KILL - the cleanest kill in this batch, and the only one carrying two independent FATALs that survived hostile re-verification. No escalation trigger fires: benches concordant at 8/10 and 8/10, no ADVANCE, not held, Q3 print ~11-12 weeks out.

THE COURT'S OWN REASON TO EXIST WAS ALREADY FALSIFIED. The triage's case was that 'no outside party can currently decompose mix versus structure' on LMB's margin break, so a court would be informative rather than decorative. Red checked and it was false as of the peer prints: Comfort Systems posted gross margin 25.9% vs 23.5% (+240bp), mechanical 25.6% vs 22.9% (+270bp); EMCOR posted consolidated GM 19.8% vs 19.4% (+40bp). Both bid the SAME data-center labor and material markets in the SAME quarter LMB's gross margin broke 650bp. That reclassifies the whole event from industry cost inflation to LMB-specific execution and underwriting failure - the one branch with no anniversary, no comp effect and no November rescue. Blue re-pulled both peer prints from primary (FIX investor PR, EMCOR 8-K EX-99.1) and confirmed the numbers, while correcting red's claim of an EMCOR 'record mechanical margin 12.5%': US Mechanical operating margin actually FELL 13.6% -> 12.5%. That correction is real and it is the single datum a bull can point to for industry softness, but a 110bp peer operating-margin dip cannot rehabilitate a 650bp gross-margin break when the direct mechanical comp expanded 270bp and raised guidance.

THE SECOND FATAL IS MANAGEMENT'S OWN GUIDANCE. The FY adjusted-EBITDA guide was cut from $90-94M to $78-84M while the revenue guide was RAISED from $730-760M to $760-790M, and the revised guide EXCLUDES any contribution from the just-closed CYMCOR acquisition. Adding roughly $30M of revenue while removing $12-16M of EBITDA is management pricing negative organic incrementals - and it lands on an H2 that is entirely POST-anniversary of the Pioneer close. The triage's rescue leg was that Pioneer mix dilution anniversaries on 7/1; management's own language is that Pioneer margins reach the company average over 'two to three years'. The drag persists inside the organic base, and the company has already told you the mix rescue is not coming.

BLUE STRENGTHENED THE ARITHMETIC RATHER THAN SOFTENING IT. Red's mix fork: ODR H1 revenue $228.2M on $53.7M gross profit (23.5%), with Pioneer contributing $54.5M - so holding legacy ODR at last year's 29% requires Pioneer to be running about 6.1% gross margin, which is not credible for a $66.6M purchase; at a plausible 18% Pioneer margin, legacy ODR is 25.3%, i.e. 370bp of organic erosion. Either branch is bearish - a value-destroying acquisition or core erosion. Blue found the 10-Q attributes Pioneer's $54.5M to TOTAL revenue, unallocated by segment, which means if any of it sits in GCR the legacy-ODR-at-29% branch becomes arithmetically IMPOSSIBLE. Blue also added the finding red missed and it is the most damning line in the record: ODR gross profit fell in DOLLARS - Q2 $30.8M vs $31.6M, H1 $53.7M vs $57.8M - on 18% and 15% revenue growth. Negative incremental gross profit in the good segment.

AND THE FLOW STORY INVERTS. The triage's third leg was that the Capital Group overhang is behind the stock: CII went 823,702 shares / 7.1% to zero by 6/30/26, with the 13G/A merely disclosing it on 8/12. Both benches confirm the exit but read it correctly - the distribution completed BEFORE the Q2 print, the tape was FLAT while 7.1% of the company was sold, and the stock then fell another ~40% AFTER the supply had cleared. Supply was absorbed without price damage; what followed is fundamental repricing. There is no forced seller here, which is the doctrine test a dislocation has to pass.

On valuation: 7.0-7.6x EV/EBITDA against the already-cut guide is an anchor, not a floor, because the denominator is still falling and management has guided it lower. Adjusted EPS was $0.64 vs $0.93 (-31% YoY) on +21.9% revenue - a real earnings decline, not the consensus whipsaw the triage argued from the sequential $0.64/$0.64 framing. Both benches rate this 3/10 court-worthy until a clean organic datapoint exists; it should stop re-queueing.

court.record: batch4 8/15; red 8/blue 8 SUSTAINED, one citation corrected - outcome CONCORDANT. Blue re-verified both FATALs from primary sources, corrected a non-load-bearing EMCOR citation against red, and STRENGTHENED the mix arithmetic.

reopen_gates: DATA: disclosed Pioneer standalone gross margin >= 18% TOGETHER WITH legacy ODR >= 27%. Both legs are required - this is the only disclosure that rehabilitates the mix arithmetic, and blue showed one branch may be arithmetically impossible.
EVENT: Q3 clean organic ODR gross margin >= 26% ex-CYMCOR. Note the comp is already partially spoiled - CYMCOR closed 8/4 and enters Q3 mid-quarter - so insist on the ex-CYMCOR cut, not the headline.

CONTROL TEST (faster and cheaper than waiting for LMB): FIX and EME Q3 mechanical margins. If THEY compress, the event reclassifies to industry-wide and the idiosyncratic-execution kill weakens. This is the highest-information re-test and it does not require LMB to report.
FLOW: material open-market insider buying at these levels - absent through the entire decline.
